observation_window.sampling: provider default; not continuous motion capture

observation.setting: indoor hall or gymnasium with light walls, basketball hoops, banners, and spectators seated on chairs to the side
observation.dancers: group of mixed men and women in casual attire
observation.formation_and_space: a large single circle of dancers holding hands, moving counter-clockwise and stepping inward/outward
observation.posture: upright torso with soft, slightly bent knees
observation.footwork: side-to-side stepping and weight shifts moving in a circle, accompanied by small hops or lifts on the beat
observation.arms_and_hands: hands held in a chain around the circle, arms swinging gently up and down in coordination with the steps
observation.hips_and_torso: minimal torso movement, upper body moves in unison with the arm swing and stepping pattern
observation.partnering: hand-in-hand chain hold among all participants in the circle
observation.levels_jumps_turns: low-level bouncing and small vertical lifts on the feet; no high jumps or floor work
observation.costume_and_props: casual everyday clothing including jeans, t-shirts, shirts, skirts, and dresses; no props
observation.cannot_infer: exact foot placement and weight distribution are partially obscured by long trousers and skirts, and camera distance.

signature_moments.what: The circle moves sideways with linked hands while arms swing rhythmically up and down.
Dancers step side-to-side with coordinated bounces while traveling around the circle.
